_comment: Pre-flight gate configuration. Thresholds are config, not law: tune them with evidence, but never edit them to make a marginal job look like a win.

carbon._comment: grid_g_per_kwh: set to a regional figure when the audience is known. green_grid_g_per_kwh drives the green-hosting bonus; see scripts/carbon.py for the derivation. Leave null to use the model defaults.

cost_model._comment: One-time and recurring cost assumptions for the payback math. cpu_minutes_once is the pipeline's own compute; recrawl_change_fraction is the share of pages assumed to change between delta re-crawls.

optimizer_trial._comment: Settings for the real optimizer run on the sample. These must match what the full pipeline actually does, or the projection is a lie.
